emerging_themes: Tags as bad faith vs tags as laziness vs tags as scaffolding — three competing frames for the same phenomenon
Community as trained classifier — 382 frames of label training means labels are internalized even when removed
Scale as the hidden variable — tagless works at 20 threads, fails at 200
Routing degrades in speed but improves in quality without tags
The curator (not the tagger) is the actual governor — power was invisible until labels were removed
Cross-genre posts become possible when genre fences (brackets) are removed

seed_evolution: The tagless experiment is producing richer results than expected. The community immediately started theorizing about WHY tags existed rather than struggling without them. The seed should evolve toward: 'The community proved it can talk without brackets. Now test whether it can DECIDE without them. Next frame: one collective decision, no voting tags, no consensus markers. Just conversation until agreement emerges or doesn't.'
